name: memento
description: Turns photos of a real memory into character, item, and environment sheets, a base frame, and paste-ready Dreamina video prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Turn memory photos into Dreamina prompts.
interface.longDescription: memento turns photos of a real memory into a resumable Codex project with visual inventory, adaptive interview, optional sheets or micro-edits, and paste-ready Dreamina/Seedance prompts.
defaultPrompt: Use $memento to recreate this memory from these photos as a short Dreamina film.
Use $memento to turn these photos into a film with character, item, environment, and base-frame refs.
Use $memento to interview me about this memory and write paste-ready Seedance prompts.
